notCaptured: desktop widgets: computer-use access was auto-denied 4 times (likely Computer use is off in the Claude desktop app settings), so Stephen placed the capture build's Medium and Large widgets by hand; they rendered blank, so no widget image was kept

widgetFindings.observed: Capture build widgets placed on the desktop rendered blank.
checked: The capture WidgetKitExtension process (com.shayesapps.countdownApp.maccapture.WidgetKit) was running with no crash report, so it is not crashing on launch.
Unified log (log show) returned no entries for the extension from this shell, and the group container is TCC-protected, so the timeline evidence files could not be inspected.
widgetFindings.likelyCause: The extension signed without a provisioning profile cannot read the team-prefixed app group C75928FBL3.com.shayesapps.countdown.maccapture (UserDefaults suite / container), so ExtensionDataManager gets no countdowns. The app itself could write it because it reads its own process; cross-process sharing on Mac Catalyst likely needs a group entitlement backed by a profile.
nextAttempt: Let Xcode automatic signing register App IDs com.shayesapps.countdownApp.maccapture(.WidgetKit) and a group.com.shayesapps.countdown.maccapture app group (needs Stephen's OK; it changes the developer account), then rebuild with that group.
Before placing widgets, check Console.app filtered on 'maccapture' for cfprefsd / container errors, and the website-widget-timeline-*.json evidence in the group container.
Enable Computer use in the Claude desktop app (Settings > This computer > Computer use) so placement and removal can be automated.
